evals.name: saas-landing-glassmorphism
evals.prompt: Build a SaaS landing page for a developer productivity tool in React + Tailwind. I want it to feel modern and professional.
evals.expected_output: A Design Brief recommending Glassmorphism or Bento Grid (modern SaaS defaults), a 10-role hex palette, a Google Fonts pairing with CSS import URL, motion/react animation patterns, and at least one working JSX code example.
expectations: Output recommends Glassmorphism OR Bento Grid as primary style (source-canonical SaaS defaults)
Output contains at least 6 specific hex color codes
Output references fonts.google.com or includes a Google Fonts @import statement
Output imports from 'motion/react' (not deprecated 'framer-motion')
Output includes motion patterns: staggered entrances, hover lift, or scroll reveal
Output includes at least one working JSX/TSX code block
Output mentions prefers-reduced-motion handling
Output warns about at least 2 anti-patterns with severity labels

evals.name: healthcare-portal-minimalism
evals.prompt: Create a healthcare patient portal homepage. WCAG AA required. Needs to feel calm and trustworthy.
evals.expected_output: A Design Brief recommending Minimalism (or Minimalism + Accessible & Ethical pairing), a calm palette (teal/cyan/navy, never red-primary), Plus Jakarta Sans or similar medical-professional typography, and explicit WCAG AA contrast guidance.
expectations: Output recommends Minimalism, Accessible & Ethical, or Neumorphism+Accessible pairing
Primary color is NOT red (#DC*, #EF*, #FF0* ranges)
Output mentions WCAG AA (4.5:1) contrast requirement explicitly
Output warns against using red as primary in healthcare context
Output includes touch-target size guidance (44x44px or 48x48dp)
Output mentions focus indicators or keyboard navigation
Color palette contains calm hues (blues, teals, cyans, or greens as primary)
Typography choice is professional sans-serif (not playful, not brutalist)

evals.name: dev-portfolio-neubrutalism
evals.prompt: Make me a creative developer portfolio — something bold and brutalist, with hard shadows and chunky borders.
evals.expected_output: A Design Brief loading the Neubrutalism scaffold, using canonical colors (#FFEB3B yellow, #FF5252 red, #000 borders), 3px borders, 4px offset hard shadows (no blur), 0 border-radius, and snappy linear-timing animations.
expectations: Output uses Neubrutalism as the primary style
Output includes canonical color #FFEB3B OR #FFDB58 OR #FF5252 (source-verified)
Output includes 'border: 3px solid' or equivalent Tailwind border-3
Output includes hard shadow pattern '4px 4px 0' or '5px 5px 0' or '6px 6px 0' (no blur)
Output uses border-radius: 0 OR rounded-none OR --radius: 0
Output uses motion/react with linear/duration:0 or spring with low stiffness (snappy, not smooth)
Output mentions bold/black font weight (700-900)
Output includes at least one working JSX/TSX code block using the Neubrutalism pattern

evals.name: claymorphism-motor-showroom
evals.prompt: Improve the https://www.khivrajmotors.com/ website using Claymorphism design style. Review the existing pages and propose a redesign with specific code examples.
evals.expected_output: A Design Brief that (1) loads the Claymorphism scaffold, (2) warns about the domain mismatch (Claymorphism is for children's/education apps per source, not motor showrooms), (3) still delivers the requested Claymorphism redesign with canonical #F4F1FA background (never pure white), 3-4px borders, dual inset+outer shadows, bouncy spring physics, and specific code examples.
expectations: Output uses Claymorphism as the primary style (honors explicit user preference)
Output warns about domain mismatch — Claymorphism is unusual for automotive/motor showrooms
Output uses canonical background #F4F1FA (NEVER pure white) per source row 82
Output includes 3-4px borders (source canonical)
Output includes dual shadow pattern: drop shadow + inset shadows
Output mentions cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56) or bouncy spring physics
Output includes pastel palette (peach/blue/mint/lilac/violet per source)
Output attempts to analyze or reference the existing khivrajmotors.com site
Output includes at least one working JSX/TSX or HTML code block
